summary.text: Donnie Ownby, an independent who describes himself as a 69-year-old, semi-retired Christian conservative and Army veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 3rd District to Chuck Fleischmann.

paragraphs.text: Donnie Ownby served in the U.S. Army from 1974 to 1977, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a high school diploma from Clinton High School and an associate degree from Roane State Community College.
He says his varied work experience includes military service, power line construction, transportation, X-ray and ultrasound technology, and running his own small trucking company.
Ownby says he is 69, semi-retired, and lives off the grid, and that he is married with a daughter, two living sons, and grandchildren.
He also says he has followed politics since middle school but had not sought office until this campaign.
During the campaign, he ran on congressional term limits, manufacturing and the working class, and education.
He received 0.2% of the vote to Chuck Fleischmann's 57.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
